Coca-Cola to Invest $10 Billion in US Infrastructure

Coca-Cola announced plans to invest $10 billion in United States infrastructure by 2030. The company's Chief Financial Officer (CFO) stated the investment is aimed at supporting growth within the U.S. The specific details of the infrastructure projects were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
